original_text: <!-- (Audio) Brian: If we all agreed on everything, we might miss important details, don't you think? Lisa: I understand, but sometimes too much disagreement can slow things down. -->
translated_text: <!-- (Audio) Brian: Ako se svi složimo na sve, možda ćemo propustiti važne detalje, zar ne misliš? Lisa: Razumem, ali ponekad previše neslaganja može usporiti stvari. -->
